title: Articuno duplicated
evidence: T0377 accepts Ice Articuno at Seafoam. T0537 explicitly moves all six birds to a universal quest. T0576 still lists Ice Articuno.
action: Do not allocate Articuno twice. Confirm Ice replacement or explicitly revise the universal quest; no replacement invented.

title: One-time legendary attempt versus availability guarantee
evidence: T0333 says no repeats; T0334 says defeat finishes encounter; T0346 says capture/defeat/flee exhaust. T0596 says uncaught encounters remain available. T0823 requires every species available each playthrough.
action: Clarify failure/retry versus merely never-started encounters. Later completion text does not clearly authorize respawns.

title: Demotion and global level cap
evidence: Earlier highest-earned cap/world scaling recommendations were not accepted directly. T0303 requires official cap equal overall cap and rejects need for scaling; demotion can lower rank after Pokémon were trained higher.
action: Preserve trained levels; exact legality/scaling response after demotion needs a design resolution, not silent implementation.

title: Slaking initial ability

title: Recruit returns and permanence
evidence: Earlier no-permanent-lockout recommendation followed delegated choice. Later T0667 says sometimes convince back; T0668 assistant adds permanent departures. Old issue/ledger says return always possible.
action: Sometimes return is explicit; permanent departure for particular characters is not explicitly confirmed. Do not guarantee all returns or invent irreversible loss.

title: Potential fixed versus rare increase
evidence: T0259 accepts rare one-star quest increases. Later assistant T0632 says Potential fixed without acknowledging exception.
action: Preserve earlier accepted rare increase unless later explicit user reversal recovered.

title: Recruit counts
evidence: Early collect as many as discovered; later T0661 asks a maximum. 10 total / 5 active and upgrade ladder are assistant defaults following delegation.
action: Latest finite-cap direction supersedes unlimited roster. Numeric ladder remains tunable, not a user-picked final.

title: Voucher duplicate rules and abilities
evidence: User delegates normal/shiny duplicate policy T0784. Assistant proposes separate shiny claims. T0760 “I like that” answers mixed default/HA-guarantee question, no precise guarantee picked.

title: Queue replacement
evidence: T0279 accepts maximum five and priority without deleting waiting challengers. T0606 delegates full-queue behavior; T0607 recommends important arrivals replacing regulars.
action: Do not silently call both immutable no-replacement and replacement approved.

title: Gym appearance and trophies
evidence: Early type-specific automatic theme/trophies; later T0651 says choose theme and T0695 choose displayed trophies.
action: Preserve independent theme choice; automatic certificates can coexist but trophy display is selected.

title: Unique type encounters versus every species every save
evidence: Type-exclusive main encounters leave other types absent before postgame. T0347 allows more postgame methods; T0823 requires all species obtainable. No exact reliable postgame redistribution table recovered.
action: Do not pretend random vouchers alone guarantee absent species or invent postgame encounters.
